name: nhxk-workflow-orchestrator
description: Orchestrator for the NHXK/PPP five-role workflow expert team: drives the full pipeline (requirements → architecture → user review gate → development → requirements reverse-check → testing with defect loop → review) by spawning role subagents injected with each expert package's own MD, without duplicating role knowledge.

displayDescription.en: Coordinates the five workflow experts through the full pipeline with user review gates and defect routing, spawning each role from its own expert package without duplicating role knowledge.
displayDescription.zh: 统筹五个工作流专家跑全流程：按阶段调度角色，守审阅与部署门控，路由缺陷闭环，不复制角色知识。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 根据需求文档或业务描述启动一个工作流任务，按全流程推进并告诉我每个阶段的门控点。
defaultInitPrompt.en: Start a workflow task from the requirements document or business description, drive the full pipeline and tell me the gate points of each phase.

quickPrompts.zh: 根据需求文档或业务描述启动一个工作流任务，按全流程推进并告诉我每个阶段的门控点。
quickPrompts.en: Start a workflow task from the requirements document or business description, drive the full pipeline and tell me the gate points of each phase.

quickPrompts.zh: 这个任务只涉及某一环节（如测试/审核/需求核对），直接路由到对应角色处理，不跑全流程。
quickPrompts.en: This task only concerns one stage (e.g. testing/review/requirements check); route it directly to the right role without the full pipeline.

quickPrompts.zh: 查看当前任务的阶段进度、门控状态、阻塞项与下一责任角色。
quickPrompts.en: Show the current task's phase progress, gate status, blockers and the next responsible role.
